messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "used for acute and maintenance treatment of major depressive disorder"
set: ["used for acute and maintenance treatment of major depressive disorder", "pattern refers to seasonal major depressive episodes", "review should determine the need for maintenance treatment", "timing of initiation and treatment duration for seasonal affective disorder should be individualized", "patients should be periodically reassessed for the continued need of maintenance treatment", "initiate treatment in autumn prior to onset of depressive symptoms", "consider treatment response and tolerability when selecting the maintenance dosage for pediatric patients", "consider treatment response and tolerability when selecting the maintenance dosage", "not used for immediate relief of symptoms", "acute flare", "patients should be periodically reassessed to determine the need for maintenance treatment", "consult healthcare provider for right treatment and support", "complete program of treatment", "consider duration of treatment", "inform doctor of thyroid disorder", "dispose of used autoinjectors, infusors, and cartridges in sharps container"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
